quotes.quote: Free to start with consumption credits based on usage. ZoomInfo doesn't charge by fixed seat tiers: teams pay for the credits they use, so cost scales with how much data and how many workflows they run. ZoomInfo Lite is a permanent free plan with no credit card required. See ZoomInfo pricing for current details.

Flat fee pricing offers predictable costs and unrestricted usage, while credit models limit volume. ZoomInfo uses platform-based access rather than per-credit constraints, supporting continuous prospecting.
